WITH grouped AS (
  SELECT t.account_id,
         d.A3 AS region,
         SUM(CASE WHEN t.type = 'PRIJEM' THEN t.amount
                  WHEN t.type = 'VYDAJ' THEN -t.amount END) AS net_amount,
         COUNT(*) AS record_count
  FROM trans AS t
  JOIN account AS a ON a.account_id = t.account_id
  JOIN district AS d ON d.district_id = a.district_id
  GROUP BY t.account_id, d.A3
),
total AS (
  SELECT SUM(net_amount) AS overall_net
  FROM grouped
)
SELECT g.account_id,
       g.region,
       g.net_amount,
       g.record_count,
       CAST(g.net_amount AS REAL) / NULLIF(t.overall_net, 0) AS share
FROM grouped AS g
CROSS JOIN total AS t
ORDER BY share DESC
LIMIT 10
